facts.business: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited (GSFC) is a joint sector enterprise promoted by the Government of Gujarat that manufactures and markets a diverse portfolio of bulk and non-bulk fertilizers (Urea, DAP, NPK, Ammonium Sulphate, Ammonium Phosphate Sulphate) and industrial chemicals (Caprolactam, Nylon-6, Melamine, HX Sulphate Crystal), and is the country's sole producer of Melamine and HX Sulphate Crystal.
key_risks: Assessment of implications of Government policies/notifications on recognition of subsidy revenue and its recoverability
